## What I do

I take ideas from first conversation to shipped product — scoping, architecting, building, deploying, and standing behind the result. No handoffs.

- **Web development** — React, Next.js, TypeScript; design systems, performance, SEO, payments, auth
- **Mobile applications** — iOS (Swift, SwiftUI), Android (Kotlin), React Native; push notifications, payments, App Store shipping
- **AI & machine learning** — LLM apps, AI agents, RAG pipelines, evals and traces; LangChain, LangGraph, Hugging Face
- **Backend & APIs** — Node.js, NestJS, FastAPI; PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB, Supabase; AWS / Vercel
- **Commerce** — Shopify (custom themes, Liquid, headless), WooCommerce, custom CRMs
- **Automation** — Workflow automation, scrapers, Telegram/WhatsApp bots, internal panels

## Selected work

- **PowerSell** (2025) — Gamified real-estate lead platform with role-based dashboards, real-time pipelines, and conversion analytics. Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, WebSockets. https://app.powersell.io
- **SweeTreats** (2025) — Cross-platform food and drink app for iOS and Android. Stack: React Native, TypeScript, Firebase.
- **Okasha Smart Shopify** (2024) — Custom Shopify storefront for smart-home products. Stack: Shopify, Liquid, JavaScript, Tailwind. https://okashasmart.com
- **HBD MM** (2026) — iOS lifestyle and game app. Stack: Swift, SwiftUI, CloudKit.
- **India Rare** (2026) — Conversion-focused direct-to-consumer e-commerce storefront. Stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind. https://indiarare.com
- **EditDeck Pro** — AI-powered editing platform.
- **SolarMax** — Shopify e-commerce platform for solar products.
- **UPVC Cloud** — ERP web application.
- **IDRAK** — Student information system.

## How I work

- **Scope first.** Fuzzy goals become shipped products. Clarity first, code second.
- **Ship production-grade.** Infrastructure is the product. No "we'll fix it later" code.
- **Own the work.** I scope, lead, build, and stand behind the result. No handoffs.
